snippet.title: Spinjitzu Smash - New Game+ Playthrough
snippet.description:
Spinjitzu Smash series is something I used to love playing back when I was 9-10 years old. At the time, I was just a big fan of Lego games, and I really happened to like this series. At the time, I had no idea that the combat system was stolen from Megaman Battle Network series, but honestly, I have to thank Spinjitzu Smash series for introducing me to Megaman Battle Network.
The Spinjitzu Smash series got removed from Lego website just about a year after final 6th game came out unfortunately. 2 games got preserved, 1 game only got its demo preserved, and 3 games are gone forever. Yeah, if you want to play this series nowadays, your choice of games is very limited. The 3 games that got preserved are in Flashpoint by the way.
Back when I was 9-10, I actually had no idea how to progress in the game and I only ended up fighting 2 bosses I believe. 3 if you count the fact I got the final boss in a random encounter at one point. That actually happened, believe it or not. Looking back, it's a pretty short game that can be beaten in about 3 hours from a fresh save. I had no idea this game had a New Game+ mode and decided to record just that.
Also, I believe I'm actually the first person to upload the whole game on youtube, 9 years after its release. That's just surprising for me.

0:00 Kai's Campaign
5:34 Boss 1: Fire Dragon
6:10 Cole's Campaign
11:35 Boss 2: Earth Dragon
12:22 Zane's Campaign
17:48 Boss 3: Ice Dragon
18:10 Jay's Campaign
23:14 Boss 4: Lightning Dragon
24:07 Final Campaign
29:48 Final Boss: Samukai
---
